verdict.rationale: Supabase's own docs say every project is a full Postgres database and "100% portable", so the data sits in an open, standard format. Storage speaks the S3-compatible protocol, and the open-source stack can be self-hosted with Docker Compose for full control of the data, which gives a credible exit path. However, the pack never documents an actual export or migration-off procedure, so the story is only roughly half evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented full-project export workflow (e.g., a database dump command or downloadable backups), export of Auth users and Storage objects in bulk, a guide for migrating off the hosted platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.
